name: Nexora — internal research, requirements and proposals

parameters.content:
# Nexora internal runner
1. Create Nexora runner credential (Agent control → n8n).
2. Set Header Auth on all Nexora HTTP nodes: Authorization = Bearer <runner token>.
3. Set Gemini Header Auth: x-goog-api-key = your API key. Never put keys in this workflow JSON.
4. Check the Gemini model available in your account.
5. Enable model processing + runner in Nexora. Execute manually, inspect saved results, then publish this workflow.

No messages, invitations, profile edits, orders, payments or posts are executed here. At most two internal tasks/run. No automatic HTTP retries. Google Search grounding/quota can incur provider charges. Keep execution data private.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: "gemini-3.8-flash", store: false, system_instruction: $json.instructions, input: JSON.stringify({job: $json.job.type, input: $json.job.input, record: $json.record, settings: $json.settings, outputSchema: $json.outputSchema}), ...(["research","profile_research","content","discover"].includes($json.job.type) ? {tools:[{type:"google_search"}]} : {}) }) }}
